assessment.nobel_worthiness: An exceptional novelistic achievement whose encyclopedic forms, verbal invention and intellectual play have enlarged the possibilities of postwar fiction.
assessment.attribution: Credit Thomas Pynchon alone for a body of fiction that joins systems of power, scientific knowledge and countercultural imagination.
assessment.maturity: The major novels indicate a long, highly distinctive and sustained oeuvre of unusual formal ambition.
uncertainties: Assessment of the full corpus, including later work, remains necessarily incomplete.
The scale of international reception through translation is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A major poetic project of mythic and fragmented invention that remakes Arabic lyric while sustaining a searching engagement with inherited forms.
assessment.attribution: Credit Adonis alone for the poetry and essays renewing Arabic poetic language through a distinctive modernist idiom.
assessment.maturity: The representative books suggest exceptional duration and depth across poetry and criticism.
uncertainties: My access to the Arabic originals and the full range of translations is limited.
The balance of achievement across the entire oeuvre requires fuller corpus coverage.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary and densely organized prose gives memory, embodiment and metaphysical speculation a strikingly expansive narrative form.
assessment.attribution: Credit Mircea Cărtărescu alone for fiction and poetry distinguished by patterned imaginative architecture.
assessment.maturity: Blinding and Solenoid indicate a mature, sustained project rather than an isolated accomplishment.
uncertainties: The evaluation depends substantially on translations from Romanian.
Coverage of the poetry and less translated work is incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her uncanny narrative voices make exclusion, kinship and unstable belonging into psychologically exact yet disquieting fictional worlds.
assessment.attribution: Credit Marie NDiaye alone for fiction and drama marked by a singular handling of voice and social unease.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels point to a durable body of work with continued formal and ethical force.
uncertainties: The comparative weight of the dramatic work within the whole oeuvre needs fuller assessment.
Not all works are equally available in translation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: An unusually inventive multigenre practice remakes relations among classical scholarship, lyric, drama and narrative with formal precision and wit.
assessment.attribution: Credit Anne Carson alone for hybrid writing that has made quotation, translation, erudition and lyric inquiry integral to one recognizable oeuvre.
assessment.maturity: The range from Autobiography of Red to Nox demonstrates sustained formal innovation across decades.
uncertainties: The relative standing of the complete scholarly and translational work requires fuller coverage.
Some hybrid forms resist easy comparison with more conventional literary oeuvres.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Linguistic invention and oral storytelling animate novels of war, memory and postcolonial life with a distinctive imaginative energy.
assessment.attribution: Credit Mia Couto alone for Portuguese-language fiction and poetry that transforms oral narrative resources into an original literary idiom.
assessment.maturity: The representative novels suggest a substantial and coherent body of work with wide thematic reach.
uncertainties: Assessment of linguistic achievement is constrained by reliance on translation.
The full poetry corpus requires further consideration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: His radically inward fiction develops an unusually concentrated system of landscape, memory and mental imagery, testing the novel's relation to consciousness.
assessment.attribution: Credit Gerald Murnane alone for a singular fiction of recursive perception and imaginative landscape.
assessment.maturity: The recurrence and refinement of this method across major books indicate unusual artistic consistency.
uncertainties: The narrowness of the formal field may be judged differently when the complete oeuvre is weighed.
Full coverage of lesser-known works remains incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A long fictional career recovers divided histories through layered voices, large social worlds and sustained moral attention.
assessment.attribution: Credit Hwang Sok-yong alone for Korean-language fiction attentive to historical fracture and collective experience.
assessment.maturity: The span from The Guest to Mater 2-10 supports the case for a mature, enduring oeuvre.
uncertainties: Evaluation of the Korean originals depends on translations.
The breadth of the earlier corpus needs fuller comparative assessment.
